\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  20 & 20 & 200 \\
  20 & 20 & 200 \\
  20 & 20 & 200
\end{bmatrix}
\]

The eight Robinson responses for this window:

| N | NW | W | SW | S | SE | E | NE |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | -540 | -720 | -540 | 0 | 540 | 720 | 540 |

The east mask is the Sobel K_x kernel, so its response, 720, equals the Sobel Gx. The west mask gives the negative. The filter keeps **720**.
